rowdata.pxWarningMessage: When acquiring a lock using Obj-Open or Obj-Refresh-And-Lock you should always check to make sure the lock was actually granted. This is commonly done using StepStatusFail in the transition of the step acquiring the lock or in the precondition of the step immediately after the lock is acquired.
The use of activity rules should be limited. The need for activities can be reduced by using data transforms, as well as techniques such as case management, the Engine API, and declaratives.
